title: Canonical restriction transformation and right cocone square
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ an inverse diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with a cone $c$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $F_i$ be abelian étale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] on $D_i$ and let $\varphi_f:D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^*F_i\to F_j$ be coefficient maps [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] for arrows $f:i\to j$. Let $G:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(c.pt_{\acute et})$ have specified isomorphisms $eG_i:G_i\cong c_i^*F_i$, and let $L$ be any cocone on $G$. No identity/composition law on $\varphi$ or formula for the arrows of $G$ is assumed. Fix $X$, an index $i_0$, a map $g_0:D_{i_0}\to X$, opens $U,V$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and $q\in\mathbb N$. Write $J=I_{\ge i_0}$ and $t:J\to I$ for the inclusion. For each open $W$ put $W_j=(D(j\to i_0);g_0)^{-1}W$ and $W_L=(c_{i_0};g_0)^{-1}W$. Let $T_W^n(f)$ be pullback along the restricted transition $W_k\to W_j$, followed by cohomology of the coefficient map obtained from the inverse-image composition comparisons and the restriction of $\varphi_f$; let $\lambda_W^n(j)$ be the analogous restricted cone-projection pullback followed by the coefficient map from $(eG_j)^{-1};L_j$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. For $W=U,V$, suppose degree-indexed functors $K_W^n:J\to\operatorname{Ab}$, object isomorphisms $eW_{n,j}:K_W^n(j)\cong H^n(W_j,F_j|)$, and natural legs $\iota_W^n:K_W^n\to\mathrm{const}(H^n(W_L,L.pt|))$ are supplied, with $K_W^n(f)=eW_{n,j};T_W^n(f);eW_{n,k}^{-1}$ and $\iota_W^n(j)=eW_{n,j};\lambda_W^n(j)$. Let $H:I\to\operatorname{Ab}$ have isomorphisms $eH_i:H_i\cong H^{q+1}(D_i,F_i)$ and arrows conjugate to pullback along $D(f^{\mathrm{op}})$ followed by $H^{q+1}(\varphi_f)$. Let $B$ be a cocone on $H$ with an isomorphism $eB:B.pt\cong H^{q+1}(c.pt,L.pt)$ such that $B_i;eB=eH_i;c_i^*;H^{q+1}((eG_i)^{-1};L_i)$. Put $BP_n=H^n(W_{L,U},L.pt|)\times H^n(W_{L,V},L.pt|)$, and let $r':B.pt\to BP_{q+1}$ be $eB$ followed by the actual pair of restrictions. Given a natural transformation $\iota_4:K_U^{q+1}\oplus K_V^{q+1}\to\mathrm{const}(BP_{q+1})$ whose first and second projections are the biproduct projections followed by $\iota_U^{q+1}$ and $\iota_V^{q+1}$, there exists $r:tH\to K_U^{q+1}\oplus K_V^{q+1}$ such that $r_j;\iota_{4,j}=B_{t(j)};r'$ for all $j$. Its first component followed by $eU_{q+1,j}$ is $eH_{t(j)}$ followed by actual restriction to $U_j$, and its second component followed by $eV_{q+1,j}$ is $eH_{t(j)}$ followed by actual restriction to $V_j$. No cover or exactness is asserted.

proof.text: Construct each single-open restriction transformation with components eH followed by actual restriction followed by eK.inv. Substitute hH and hK, cancel the isomorphisms, and apply openSquareCoefficient_cohomology to the transition square to prove naturality. Pair the two transformations using biprod.lift; its projection equations give the canonical components.

For each open, substitute the canonical leg formula, cancel eK.inv;eK.hom, and use hB. The cohomology identity for the restricted projection square gives the single-open cocone equality. Apply both product projections to the desired right square, use the supplied projection identities of ι₄, and substitute those two proved single-open equalities.

theorem etale_limit_open_restriction_transform
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V : X.Opens)
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (L : Cocone G) (q : ℕ)
    (H : I ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj i ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H (F i) (q + 1)))
    (hH : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), H.map f =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (D.map f.op) (F i) (q + 1)) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map (φ f) (q + 1)) ≫ (eH j).inv)
    (B : Cocone H) (eB : B.pt ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H L.pt (q + 1)))
    (hB : ∀ i : I, B.ι.app i ≫ eB.hom =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (c.π.app (op i)) (F i) (q + 1)) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map ((eG i).inv ≫ L.ι.app i) (q + 1)))
    (i₀ : I) (g₀ : D.obj (op i₀) ⟶ X)
    (KU : ℕ → Set.Ici i₀ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eKU : ∀ n j, (KU n).obj j ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (tailStageOpen D g₀ U j).ι).obj (F j.val)) n))
    (hKU : ∀ n j k (f : j ⟶ k), (KU n).map f =
      (eKU n j).hom ≫ tailOpenCohomologyMapDegree D g₀ U F φ n f ≫ (eKU n k).inv)
    (ιU : ∀ n, KU n ⟶ (Functor.const (Set.Ici i₀)).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj L.pt) n)))
    (hιU : ∀ n j, (ιU n).app j =
      (eKU n j).hom ≫ tailOpenCohomologyLegDegree D c g₀ U F G eG L n j)
    (KV : ℕ → Set.Ici i₀ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eKV : ∀ n j, (KV n).obj j ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (tailStageOpen D g₀ V j).ι).obj (F j.val)) n))
    (hKV : ∀ n j k (f : j ⟶ k), (KV n).map f =
      (eKV n j).hom ≫ tailOpenCohomologyMapDegree D g₀ V F φ n f ≫ (eKV n k).inv)
    (ιV : ∀ n, KV n ⟶ (Functor.const (Set.Ici i₀)).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj L.pt) n)))
    (hιV : ∀ n j, (ιV n).app j =
      (eKV n j).hom ≫ tailOpenCohomologyLegDegree D c g₀ V F G eG L n j)
    (ι₄ : KU (q + 1) ⊞ KV (q + 1) ⟶ (Functor.const (Set.Ici i₀)).obj
      (AddCommGrpCat.of
        (Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj L.pt) (q + 1) ×
         Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj L.pt) (q + 1))))
    (h₄U : ∀ j, ι₄.app j ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (AddMonoidHom.fst _ _) =
      (biprod.fst : KU (q + 1) ⊞ KV (q + 1) ⟶ KU (q + 1)).app j ≫ (ιU (q + 1)).app j)
    (h₄V : ∀ j, ι₄.app j ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (AddMonoidHom.snd _ _) =
      (biprod.snd : KU (q + 1) ⊞ KV (q + 1) ⟶ KV (q + 1)).app j ≫ (ιV (q + 1)).app j)
 :
    let t : Set.Ici i₀ ⥤ I :=
      (show Monotone (fun j : Set.Ici i₀ ↦ j.val) from fun _ _ h ↦ h).functor
    let WU := (c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ U
    let WV := (c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ V
    let BP := fun n ↦ AddCommGrpCat.of
      (Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} WU.ι).obj L.pt) n ×
        Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} WV.ι).obj L.pt) n)
    let r' : B.pt ⟶ BP (q + 1) := AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
      (((cohomologyMap WU.ι L.pt (q + 1)).prod
        (cohomologyMap WV.ι L.pt (q + 1))).comp eB.hom.hom)
    let rf := fun j ↦ (eH j.val).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
      (cohomologyMap (tailStageOpen D g₀ U j).ι (F j.val) (q + 1))
    let rg := fun j ↦ (eH j.val).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
      (cohomologyMap (tailStageOpen D g₀ V j).ι (F j.val) (q + 1))
    ∃ r : t ⋙ H ⟶ KU (q + 1) ⊞ KV (q + 1),
      (∀ j, r.app j ≫ ι₄.app j = B.ι.app j.val ≫ r') ∧
      (∀ j, r.app j ≫ (biprod.fst : KU (q + 1) ⊞ KV (q + 1) ⟶
        KU (q + 1)).app j ≫ (eKU (q + 1) j).hom = rf j) ∧
      (∀ j, r.app j ≫ (biprod.snd : KU (q + 1) ⊞ KV (q + 1) ⟶
        KV (q + 1)).app j ≫ (eKV (q + 1) j).hom = rg j)
